$comment: Per core package floors for pnpm test:coverage: measured % minus 2, truncated to one decimal, from all-green runs (QA lane, 2026-10-14, after merging T12fix f4b12a6). git varies by up to 2 points between runs (timing-dependent paths), so its floor comes from the lowest all-green run. Raise as coverage grows; never lower one to make a run pass.
